scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for a conventional loan for $35,000 with a 360-month term, for a purpose other than a home purchase or refinance. I haven’t received any updates yet. Could you please tell me the current status or outcome of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still being processed?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for reaching out. I have reviewed your application. Your loan application was denied. If you would like details about the reasons for the denial, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Oh, I’m disappointed to hear that my application was denied. Yes, I would like to know the specific reason my application was not approved. Could you please explain why it was denied?
dialogue.agent: Your application was denied because the credit application was incomplete. This means some of the required information or documentation needed to fully process your loan request was missing or not provided. If you have questions about what might have been incomplete, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying that. Can you tell me specifically which parts of my application were incomplete or what information was missing? Also, since my application was denied, is there any impact on my credit or anything else I should be aware of because of this denial?
dialogue.agent:
The record only indicates that your application was considered incomplete but does not list which specific documents or information were missing. I do not have access to detailed underwriting notes or a list of incomplete items.

Regarding credit impact, the record does not include information on credit reporting or scores. I am not able to provide guidance on potential effects this denial may have on your credit. If you have further questions about your application’s status or the information in this record, I can assist with those.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for explaining what is and isn’t available in the record. I appreciate your efforts to clarify the situation, even though I wish there were more specifics about what was incomplete so I could address it.

Overall, you answered my questions clearly and professionally. I’ll end the conversation here. 

<Neutral> 

Reason: The agent was courteous and explained what information was and wasn’t available, but I wasn’t able to get all the details I needed about my denial. This was understandable given the limitations, but it left me without a clear next step.
